tools.name: reviewshake_list_locations
tools.description: List the locations (branches) on this Reviewshake account, with their slugs. Use a location slug in reviewshake_subscribe_customer. Reviewshake API: GET /api/v1/locations.

tools.name: reviewshake_list_reviews
tools.description: List reviews collected for this account, newest first, with rating, text and source. Filter by rating, client, location, review source or date range. Reviewshake API: GET /api/v1/reviews.

tools.name: reviewshake_list_invitations
tools.description: List the review invitations Reviewshake has sent, optionally for one client. Use it to check whether a customer was invited. Reviewshake API: GET /api/v1/invitations.

tools.name: reviewshake_list_widgets
tools.description: List the review widgets (embeddable review displays) on this account, with their type and settings. Reviewshake API: GET /api/v1/widgets.

tools.name: reviewshake_get_widget
tools.description: Get one review widget by id, with its type and settings. Reviewshake API: GET /api/v1/widgets/{id}.

tools.name: reviewshake_subscribe_customer
tools.description: Subscribe one customer to a review campaign, so Reviewshake sends them a review invitation. This contacts a real person: send only when the user asked. Give an email or a phone number. Reviewshake API: POST /api/v1/customer/subscribe.

tools.name: reviewshake_unsubscribe_customer
tools.description: Stop review invitations for one customer, found by email or phone. This changes who gets messages: send only when the user asked. Reviewshake API: POST /api/v1/customer/unsubscribe.

tools.name: reviewshake_create_widget
tools.description: Create a review widget (an embeddable review display) with the chosen type. The widget is public once embedded on a site. Reviewshake API: POST /api/v1/widgets.

tools.name: reviewshake_delete_widget
tools.description: Delete one review widget. It cannot be undone, and embeds of it stop working. Pass confirm: true only when the user asked for this deletion. Reviewshake API: DELETE /api/v1/widgets/{id}.

tools.name: reviewshake_delete_review_sources
tools.description: Delete one or more review sources (the Google, Facebook or other review pages the account collects from). It cannot be undone. Pass confirm: true only when the user asked for this deletion. Reviewshake API: DELETE /api/v1/bulk_review_sources.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: reviewshake_list_reviews, reviewshake_list_invitations, reviewshake_list_widgets, reviewshake_get_widget · Private data: reviewshake_subscribe_customer · Public sink: reviewshake_subscribe_customer, reviewshake_unsubscribe_customer, reviewshake_create_widget · Destructive: reviewshake_delete_widget, reviewshake_delete_review_sources.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: reviewshake_list_reviews, reviewshake_list_invitations, reviewshake_list_widgets, reviewshake_get_widget · Private data: reviewshake_subscribe_customer · Public sink: reviewshake_subscribe_customer, reviewshake_unsubscribe_customer, reviewshake_create_widget · Destructive: reviewshake_delete_widget, reviewshake_delete_review_sources

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
